scores.note: Diff is test-only (internal/tally/parse_test.go added), so no production behaviour can change; static and verification gates passed.
Three tests, all for Parse's line-shape, bad-day and non-positive-duration branches.
Test-only diff and static gate passed; no rule counts before/after are carried, so this rests on the gate result alone.
Request names internal/tally/tally_test.go but the builder added a new internal/tally/parse_test.go; the tests are on-target but the file choice departs from the request without explanation.
Only the three test functions needed for the uncovered branches were added.
Parse is defined in internal/tally/tally.go and its existing tests live in tally_test.go; parse_test.go creates a second home for Parse tests.
Tests assert on the exact error text, the line number named in it, and that no entries are returned for 0m and -1h; they fail if the guards are removed.
No verifier report and no coverage delta for the Parse branches; the only evidence is a gate pass, which does not show the new tests reach the previously untested branches.

main() was restructured into run(args, stdin, stdout, stderr) int with os.Exit moved to the caller; equivalence is argued by reading only, with no before/after run of the binary recorded and only gate results as evidence.
A gardening PR that both restructures production code (main.go) and adds tests; the refactor is a means to testability, but a reviewer must judge a production change inside a test-only cleanup.
Static gate passed and no guardrail, baseline or coverage file is touched; no before/after counts are carried.
Four tests cover stdin totals, file argument, missing file and malformed line; the production refactor goes beyond adding tests and is not explained by any report.
Changing main.go was needed for in-process tests, but no report argues a smaller diff was not possible, and the change touches every exit path.
Keeps main as wiring around a run() function with injected readers and writers, the pattern the repo's cmd/tally uses.
Tests assert on exact stdout, empty stderr, exit code and the 'tally: line 2: ' prefix, so they would fail on a changed column or dropped diagnostic.
No verifier report and no before/after output of the binary; gates passed but nothing shows the refactored binary behaves as the old main did.
Diff adds only flags_test.go, a test-only change; gates passed.
Two tests for one thing: the flag-parse failure path of run().
Test-only diff and static gate passed; no before/after counts carried.
Request is identical to PR 19's (run_01M7Z7WF8G0170B4699R3CBDHN); this run files a second attempt at the same request and it is not recorded whether PR 19 already covered the flag path.
Only the flag-failure path is tested; no production code changed.
Calls run() and reuses the twoProjects fixture from main_test.go, the existing test shape.
Asserts exit code 1, empty stdout, and that stderr names the unknown or valueless flag; these fail if flag errors are swallowed.
No verifier report and no coverage or run output; a gate pass is the only evidence that the new tests run and pass.

Added exactly the total line on the all-projects path and updated the two tests whose expected output it changed.
Two production lines in main.go and a six-line GrandTotal helper; no new flags or dependencies.
GrandTotal mirrors ProjectTotal, the same Fprintf and Format column is reused, and summing stays in internal/tally.
TestGrandTotalSumsEveryEntry checks an exact Total value across mixed projects, and the stdout tests pin the exact total line and its absence under --project.
